cards.audioText: Your callsign is ACA909; your destination is Beijing, and you are leaving 1,200m and say good-bye to Wuhan Tower. Contact Wuhan Departure, and request to climb.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是加航909，你的目的地是北京，你现在离开1200米，和武汉塔台说了再见。联系武汉离场，请求爬升。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA909, leaving 1,200m, request further climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，加航909，离开1200米，请求进一步爬升。

cards.audioText: ACA909, Wuhan Departure, good morning, radar contact, follow ZF-01 Departure, climb to 1,800 m on QNH 1013.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航909，武汉离场，早上好，雷达识别，ZF-01离场，爬升至1800米，QNH1013。
cards.referenceText: Follow ZF-01 Departure, climb to 1,800 m on QNH1013, ACA909
cards.referenceTextZh: ZF-01离场，爬升至1800米，QNH1013，加航909。

cards.audioText: You just reached 1,800 m, and you got some moderate chop at the level, inform the controller about that and request 4,500 m.
cards.audioTextZh: 你刚到达1800米，你在此高度遇到中度颠簸，告知管制员这个清况，请求上4500米
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA909, maintaining 1,800 m, we have encountered moderate turbulence, request 4,500 m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，加航909，在1800米保持，我们遇到了中度颠簸，请求上4500米。

cards.audioText:
ACA909, Departure, unable to approve 4,500 m due traffic, 3,900 m available
[Tell the controller that you want to climb to 3,900 m]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航909，离场，由于航空器，不同意上4500米，3900米可用。
[告诉管制员你想爬升至3900米]
cards.referenceText: We accept 3,900 m, ACA909
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们接受3900米，加航909。

cards.audioText: Inform the controller that the weather radar shows a cumulonimbus on route ahead about 30 Km, and your level is 3,900 m.
cards.audioTextZh: 告知管制员，气象雷达显示前方30千米处有积雨云，你高度为3900米
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA909, maintaining 3,900 m; the radar indicates a CB ahead of us, about 30 km
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，加航909，在3900米保持，雷达显示前方大概30千米处有积雨云。

cards.audioText:
Roger, report your intentions.
[Tell the controller that you want radar guidance to go round the CB.]
cards.audioTextZh:
收到，报告你的意图。
[告诉管制员，你希望雷达引导，避开积雨云]
cards.referenceText: Request radar vector to circumnavigate the weather ahead. ACA909
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求雷达引导，避开前方天气，加航909。

cards.audioText: ACA909, turn left heading 300.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航909，左转航向300。
cards.referenceText: Left heading 300, ACA909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向300，加航909。

cards.audioText:
ACA909, now you are clear of weather, climb to 4,500 m, turn right heading 030 to rejoin the ZF-1 departure.
[Acknowledge the controller's instruction and tell him you want to fly to ZF directly from present position.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航909，你现在脱离天气了，爬升至4500米，右转航向030，再次加入ZF-1离场程序。
[认收管制员指令，告诉管制员你想从当前位置直飞ZF]
cards.referenceText: Roger, climb to 4,500 m. Request direct to ZF. ACA909
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，爬升至4500米，请求直飞ZF，加航909。

cards.audioText: ACA909, cleared direct to ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航909，可以直飞ZF。
cards.referenceText: Roger, direct to ZF.ACA909
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，直飞ZF，加航909。

cards.audioText: ACA909, maintain 4,500 m, contact Wuhan Control on 118.1
cards.audioTextZh: 加航909，在4500米保持，联系武汉区调118.1。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 4,500 m, 118.1, ACA909.

cards.audioText: You are just over ZF, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: [你刚飞过ZF，与武汉区调做初始联络]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA909, 4,500 m, over ZF.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航909，,4500米，过ZF。

cards.audioText: ACA909, Wuhan Control, radar contact, climb to 8,900 m
cards.audioTextZh: 加航909，武汉区调，雷达识别，爬升至8900米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, climb to 8,900 m, ACA909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，爬升至8900米，加航909。

cards.audioText: A flight attendant told you that there is a male passenger suffering a heart attack. Inform the controller about that, and tell him you want to go back to Wuhan. This is an urgent call.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名乘务员告诉你，一名男性乘客遭遇心脏病。告知管制员情况，告诉他你想返回武汉，这是一个紧急呼叫
cards.referenceText: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan, Wuhan Control, ACA909, we have a male passenger suffering heart attack, request direct back to Wuhan.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan，武汉区调，加航909，我们有一名男性乘客遭遇心脏病，请求返回武汉。

cards.audioText: ACA909, Wuhan Control, roger Panpan. Turn right direct to ZF, and descend to 4,200 m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航909，武汉区调，收到Pan，右转直飞ZF，下降到4200米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4,200 m, turn right direct to ZF, ACA909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到4200米，右转直飞ZF，加航909。

cards.audioText:
ACA909, do you need any medical assistance?
[Tell the controller that you need a physician and an ambulance upon landing or after landing. ]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航909，你需要任何医疗援助吗？
[告诉管制员，在着陆时或者着陆后，你需要一名医生以及一辆救护车]
cards.referenceText: Affirm, we need an ambulance and a physician upon arrival. ACA909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我们在着陆时需要一辆救护车和一名医生，加航909。

cards.audioText:
Roger, an ambulance and a physician will be ready.
ACA909, Wuhan Control, maintain 4,200 m, contact Approach on 118.9
cards.audioTextZh:
收到，救护车和医生将待命。
加航909，武汉区调，保持4200米，联系进近118.9。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 4,200 m, Approach 118.9, ACA909

cards.audioText: Inform Wuhan Approach that you have a passenger suffering heart attack, and request landing priority.
cards.audioTextZh: 告知武汉进近，你有一名乘客遭遇心脏病，并请求优先着陆
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA909, 4200m, we have a passenger suffering heart attack, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，加航909，高度4200米，我们有一名乘客遭遇心脏病，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText:
ACA909, Wuhan Approach, roger, radar contact, follow ZF-01A arrival, and descend to 1,800 m on QNH 1013. Information D is valid.
[Readback the controller's instruction, and ask the detail of information D because you could not receive the information on the radio.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航909，武汉进近，收到，雷达识别，按照ZF-01A进场，下降到1800米，QNH1013，通播D有效。
[复诵管制员的指令，询问通播D的细节，因为你在无线电收不到通播。]
cards.referenceText: Roger, follow ZF-01A arrival; descend to 1,800 m on QNH 1013. Can you repeat the ATIS D, we are unable to pick up on the radio, ACA909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，按照ZF-01A进场，下降到1800米，QNH1013，你能重复通播D吗，我们无线电无法接收此通播，加航909。

cards.audioText: ACA909, Approach, surface wind 350 degrees at 3 m/s, visibility 8 Km, ILS approach, runway in use 36R, QNH 1013 Hpa.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航909，进近，地面风350度，3米每秒，能见度8千米。ILS进近，使用跑道36右，QNH1013Hpa。
cards.referenceText: ILS approach, runway in use 36R, QNH 1013Hpa. ACA909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 盲降进近，使用跑道36右，QNH1013Hpa，加航909。

cards.audioText: Inform the controller that you want to land at runway 18L visually to save time.
cards.audioTextZh: 告知管制员，为了节省时间，你想目视着陆，跑道18左
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA909, request to make a visual approach and land for runway 18L to save time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，加航909，为了节省时间，请求目视进近并在跑道18左着陆。
